title.original: Mist: Efficient Distributed Training of Large Language Models via Memory-Parallelism Co-Optimization
title.zh: Mist：通过内存—并行协同优化实现大型语言模型高效分布式训练
title.en: Mist: Efficient Distributed Training of Large Language Models via Memory-Parallelism Co-Optimization

inclusion_reason.zh: Mist 联合规划并行、内存、重叠和微批平衡并生成执行配置，是面向 LLM 训练的自动系统优化器。
inclusion_reason.en: Mist jointly plans parallelism, memory, overlap, and microbatch balance and emits executable configurations, making it an automatic systems optimizer for LLM training.

abstract.zh: Mist 联合搜索数据、张量和流水线并行以及激活重计算、冗余消除和卸载等内存优化，并显式建模重叠与微批不均衡。
abstract.en: Mist jointly searches data, tensor, and pipeline parallelism together with checkpointing, redundancy removal, and offloading, while explicitly modeling overlap and microbatch imbalance.

problem.zh: 自动并行系统通常只调一部分策略，既缺乏对重叠的认识，也难以穿越组合搜索空间，因而忽略阶段间和微批间的不平衡。
problem.en: Automatic parallelization systems usually tune only a subset of strategies, lack overlap awareness, and struggle with the combinatorial space, leaving stage and microbatch imbalance unresolved.

approach.zh: 系统结合细粒度重叠调度、符号化运行时与内存分析，以及分层优化：外层以混合整数规划平衡阶段，内层在帕累托前沿上优化阶段内部策略。
approach.en: The system combines fine-grained overlap scheduling, symbolic runtime and memory analysis, and hierarchical optimization: an outer mixed-integer program balances stages while an inner constrained search tunes each stage along a Pareto frontier.

system_design.zh: 模型与硬件特征进入符号性能模型，阶段级规划器选择并行和内存方案，阶段内优化器细化重叠时序，最终生成可执行的分布式训练配置。
system_design.en: Model and hardware features feed a symbolic performance model; a stage-level planner chooses parallelism and memory policies, an intra-stage optimizer refines overlap timing, and the system emits an executable configuration.

key_results.zh: 评测中 Mist 的训练速度优于手工配置的 Megatron-LM 和自动系统 Aceso，表明联合优化比逐项调参更有效。
key_results.en: Mist trains faster than both manually configured Megatron-LM and the automatic Aceso system in the reported evaluation, supporting joint optimization over isolated tuning.

limitations.zh: 搜索质量依赖符号模型对算子、通信和内存峰值的预测；混合整数求解和策略实现也可能限制其对新模型结构与动态集群的适应。
limitations.en: Search quality depends on symbolic predictions of operators, communication, and memory peaks; solver cost and strategy implementations may limit adaptation to new architectures or dynamic clusters.

notes.zh: 已填模型、工作负载、硬件、基线和指标均来自官方 arXiv 摘要或 comment；摘要未披露的表格明细、硬件拓扑与集群配置仍待全文审计。
notes.en: Populated models, workloads, hardware, baselines, and metrics come from the official arXiv abstract or comment; undisclosed table details, hardware topology, and cluster configuration still require full-text audit.
